artwork: Original raster schematic rendered from curated ordered line paths, not a copied official bitmap. Coordinates are diagrammatic, intermediate minor stations collapsed.
line_scope: Lines 1–18, Pujiang, Maglev, Airport Link; branch paths for 5/10/11; operating major nodes only, not unconfirmed future lines.

sources.role: Official map discovery; direct image download returned HTTP 503, used published government map and route lists for cross-check instead
Published Shanghai Metro topology and line-color reference, older map not treated as current opening status
Cross-check ordered stations and branch routes
2025 ridership and core-business-station selection; no station-wide precise ranking inferred
Confirmed 2025 Line18 extension to Kangwen Road and Hulan Road interchange
Airport Link operating section; not-yet-open T3 and Shanghai East are excluded

station_selection: Prioritize reported high-ridership CBD stations, major interchanges, well-known landmarks/tourism, airports/rail hubs, and representative endpoints so every operating line has map nodes. Per-station reasons are stored in shanghai_metro.json. Network fame is a qualitative design choice, not an invented quantitative ranking.
game_values: Traffic, radiation, prices and yields are fictional prototype values; economic mapping and exclusive pools tracked separately. Legacy indices0–5 retained; 虹桥枢纽 becomes 虹桥火车站 and 临港避难所 becomes 滴水湖.
